what: The Regulations reviewer on "Northside Electric Co-op, residential electric service, monthly bill"

parsed_output.quote: Shelter includes room, rent, mortgage payments, real property taxes, heating fuel, gas, electricity, water, sewerage, and garbage collection services.
parsed_output.reason_plain: Yes, this is a shelter cost. Electricity is listed by name as shelter, so someone else paying it counts as in-kind support.
parsed_output.reason_technical: 20 CFR 416.1130(b)(1) lists "electricity" in its definition of shelter. It also counts as in-kind support and maintenance any shelter "that you receive because someone else pays for it." A residential electric bill paid directly to the co-op is not income itself under 416.1103(g). However, the shelter received because of that payment is in-kind income for shelter.
